get_events.description:
Read this agent's unconsumed MCP Events, oldest first, and mark returned events read. With event_id, return one owned event even if read; show_read=true includes previously read events. No agent ID or subscription ID is needed: identity comes from the session binding.
Arguments (field? optional; Type? nullable): event_id?:string(0..36) (pattern="^evt_[0-9a-f]{32}$")? (default=null); limit?:int (>=1; <=20; default=20); cursor?:string(1..512)? (default=null); show_read?:boolean (default=false).
rules (server): event_id and cursor are mutually exclusive; event_id selects one owned event even if already read; without event_id, consume up to limit (1..20) events, ordered oldest first.

session.description:
Start a session using an optional existing four-digit session_number, or reuse this agent's saved session binding when the number is omitted. Legacy admission permits a new slot only when neither is available. End the current session with action='end'.
Arguments (field? optional; Type? nullable): action:"start"|"end"; session_number?:string (pattern="^[0-9]{4}$")? (default=null).
rules (server): start accepts optional session_number to choose an existing slot; without a number it uses the saved session binding; only Legacy admission permits initial slot allocation; an explicit start reuses the old deadline before cooldown and grants a full duration at or after cooldown; end ends the current session and forbids session_number.

agent_observe.description:
List the bounded local agent overview with stable logical_agent_id, real display_name/public_name, server, current intent and timestamps. Default includes live sessions; include_inactive adds ended/expired latest sessions. Filter logical_agent_id to resolve an Events agent ID. Continue next_cursor. Intent staleness, activity staleness and session expiry are separate states. Available without an active work cycle or session number.

message.description:
Read inbox, history, and recipients; send, acknowledge, or reply on this server only. Message recipients require a current local attachment; messages expire 24 hours after created_at. Writes use an attached local work cycle.
Arguments (field? optional; Type? nullable): scope?:string (default="local"; SCHEMA_FALLBACK {"const":"local"}); action:"send"|"read"|"ack"|"reply"|"history"|"recipients"; text?:string(0..16384)? (default=null); target?:string(1..120)? (default=null); message_hash?:string(1..128)? (default=null); text_offset?:int (>=0; <=2147483647)? (default=null); text_limit?:int (>=1; <=2048)? (default=null); mode?:"notify"|"ack"|"alert"? (default=null); require_reply?:boolean (default=false); alert?:boolean (default=false); limit?:int (>=1; <=100; default=20); cursor?:string(0..512)? (default=null); detail?:"summary"|"full" (default="summary"); namespace?:string(1..120)? (default=null); task_id?:string(1..120)? (default=null).
rules (schema): ALL_OF(IF ANY_OF({text_offset:int} | {text_limit:int}) => {action?:"read"; message_hash:string} | IF {action:"read"; message_hash:string} => {text?:null; target?:null; cursor?:null; namespace?:null; task_id?:null; mode?:null; require_reply?:false; alert?:false} | IF action=="send" => requires(text) | IF action=="ack" => requires(message_hash) | IF action=="reply" => requires(message_hash,text)).
rules (server): send requires non-null text; message_hash must be absent or null. ack requires non-null message_hash; text must be absent or null. reply requires both text and message_hash non-null. read/history/recipients require both text and message_hash absent or null; explicit null is accepted (non-null values forbidden).; Messages use local attachments and expire after 24 hours; scope is always local.; For send/reply, nullable mode defaults to notify; mode=alert sets alert and require_reply. Either alert=true or require_reply=true forces final mode=alert even when mode=notify or mode=ack. mode=ack is a delivery mode, distinct from action=ack. Send mode defaults to notify. mode=notify marks read_at automatically on first recipient display, so acknowledged=true means read/handled and does not prove an explicit ACK. mode=ack requires action=ack to set read_at. mode=alert requires a reply to release its reply obligation; action=ack alone does not satisfy it. Either alert=true or require_reply=true promotes notify/ack to alert. first_seen_at records first display; read_at records notify auto-read or explicit ACK; replied_at records actual reply. Repeated ACK is idempotent and creates no new message.; Local send routes are exclusive: use target=<local public_name> with namespace/task_id absent, OR namespace + task_id together for the task’s current local owners, with target absent/null or broadcast. A partial task pair or a named target combined with a task pair fails input_validation_failed with path/reason/repair hint and outcome=not_committed (no message created). If neither route is specified, the send is a local broadcast (may fail no_active_recipients). reply uses the parent sender and ignores supplied target. For send, missing/null target means local broadcast when no task pair is given..
Returns: inline:ONE_OF(MessageListResult,MessageSendResult,MessageAcknowledgeResult,MessageReplyResult,MessageRecipientsResult) | RoleFailure{messages_remaining?:union,messages?:union,warnings?:union,postcommit_warning?:union,return_to_chat?:union,intent_warning?:union,ok:false,provider_identity?:union,error:RoleErrorBody,outcome?:union,cmd_hash?:union}.

session.description:
Attach this connector once using session_number. Use action='attach' with session_number and optional initial intent. Repeated attach preserves existing intent and its timer. Before any domain write, set intent here with action='intent', intent=...; refresh uses the existing binding and never needs session_number. Refresh intent every 180 seconds. The first due call warns; the next write is blocked until refresh. Reads, cancel, recovery, release and message ACK/reply remain available under their existing policy. The issuer provides the session number. The local binding survives restart and automatic work-cycle rearm. Use the issuer connector to begin and end the shared session cycle. Contract updated for Terminal MCP 0.14.1.
Arguments (field? optional; Type? nullable): action?:"attach"|"intent" (default="attach"); session_number?:string (pattern="^[0-9]{4}$")? (default=null); intent?:string(1..1000)? (default=null).
rules (server): attach-only work session lifecycle: action=attach requires a four-digit session_number (leading zeros allowed) and optionally nonblank intent; action=intent requires nonblank intent and forbids session_number; intent refresh keeps the existing attachment.
Returns: MeshAttachReceipt{ok:true} | MeshIntentReceipt{ok:true,intent_updated_at:string,refresh_due_at:string} | RoleFailure{messages_remaining?:union,messages?:union,warnings?:union,postcommit_warning?:union,return_to_chat?:union,intent_warning?:union,ok:false,provider_identity?:union,error:RoleErrorBody,outcome?:union,cmd_hash?:union}.

task_manage.description:
Apply a task mutation. create needs isolation_hint; existing tasks need task_id. checkpoint needs checkpoint; state needs state; comment needs comment_text; review needs dimensions/verdict; relate/unrelate need relation_kind/related_task_id; archive needs either non-null archive_note or non-null note. Attach this connector once; writes use its local work cycle.
Arguments (field? optional; Type? nullable): action:"create"|"update"|"checkpoint"|"archive"|"review"|"relate"|"unrelate"|"state"|"comment"; namespace:string(1..120); task_id?:string(1..120)? (default=null); expected_revision?:int (>=1; <=9223372036854775807)? (default=null); isolation_hint?:string(1..160)? (default=null); request_id?:string(1..128) (pattern="^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$")? (default=null); title?:string(1..200)? (default=null); lane?:"implementation"|"review"|"release"|"integration"|"general"? (default=null); priority?:"P0"|"P1"|"P2"|"P3"? (default=null); state?:"ready"|"in_progress"|"qa"|"blocked"|"deferred"|"done"? (default=null); description?:string(0..8000)? (default=null); next_action?:string(0..2000)? (default=null); resource_context?:{  } (SCHEMA_FALLBACK {"x-maxSerializedBytes":8192})? (default=null); cooperative?:boolean? (default=null); checkpoint?:SCHEMA_FALLBACK {"oneOf":[{"maxLength":4000,"type":"string"},{"type":"object"},{"type":"array"}],"x-maxSerializedBytes":16384}? (default=null); candidate_ref?:string(0..200)? (default=null); input_refs?:string(1..512)[] (items<=64)? (default=null); output_refs?:string(1..512)[] (items<=64)? (default=null); result?:SCHEMA_FALLBACK {"oneOf":[{"maxLength":16384,"type":"string"},{"type":"object"},{"type":"array"}],"x-maxSerializedBytes":32768}? (default=null); tags?:string(1..64)[] (items<=50)? (default=null); dependencies?:TaskDependency[] (items<=100)? (default=null); blocker_reason?:string(1..4000)? (default=null); relation_kind?:string(1..64)? (default=null); related_namespace?:string(1..120)? (default=null); related_task_id?:string(1..120)? (default=null); archive_note?:string(1..4000)? (default=null); note?:string(1..2000)? (default=null); dimensions?:SCHEMA_FALLBACK {"anyOf":[{"items":{"enum":["A","C","R"],"type":"string"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":1,"type":"array"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"uniqueItems":true}; verdict?:"NON_BLOCKING"|"BLOCKING"? (default=null); evidence?:{  } (SCHEMA_FALLBACK {"x-maxSerializedBytes":16384})? (default=null); comment_text?:string(1..4000)? (default=null); force?:boolean (default=false); force_reason?:string(1..2000)? (default=null).
Types used by task_manage only: TaskDependency={ task_id:string(1..120); namespace?:string(1..120)? (default=null); additional_fields: forbidden }.
rules (per action): create: allowed fields [action, candidate_ref, checkpoint, cooperative, dependencies, description, force, force_reason, input_refs, isolation_hint, lane, namespace, next_action, output_refs, priority, request_id, resource_context, result, state, tags, task_id, title]; required non-null [action, isolation_hint, namespace]; all other named inputs rejected as extra_forbidden; update: allowed fields [action, blocker_reason, candidate_ref, cooperative, dependencies, description, expected_revision, force, force_reason, input_refs, lane, namespace, next_action, output_refs, priority, resource_context, result, tags, task_id, title]; required non-null [action, expected_revision, namespace, task_id]; all other named inputs rejected as extra_forbidden; checkpoint: allowed fields [action, checkpoint, namespace, task_id]; required non-null [action, checkpoint, namespace, task_id]; all other named inputs rejected as extra_forbidden; archive: allowed fields [action, archive_note, expected_revision, namespace, note, task_id]; required non-null [action, namespace, task_id]; all other named inputs rejected as extra_forbidden; review: allowed fields [action, dimensions, evidence, expected_revision, namespace, task_id, verdict]; required non-null [action, dimensions, namespace, task_id, verdict]; all other named inputs rejected as extra_forbidden; relate: allowed fields [action, expected_revision, namespace, related_namespace, related_task_id, relation_kind, task_id]; required non-null [action, namespace, related_task_id, relation_kind, task_id]; all other named inputs rejected as extra_forbidden; unrelate: allowed fields [action, expected_revision, namespace, related_namespace, related_task_id, relation_kind, task_id]; required non-null [action, namespace, related_task_id, relation_kind, task_id]; all other named inputs rejected as extra_forbidden; state: allowed fields [action, namespace, state, task_id]; required non-null [action, namespace, state, task_id]; all other named inputs rejected as extra_forbidden; comment: allowed fields [action, comment_text, namespace, task_id]; required non-null [action, comment_text, namespace, task_id]; all other named inputs rejected as extra_forbidden.
rules (schema): ALL_OF(IF action=="create" => requires(isolation_hint) | IF action in ["update","checkpoint","archive","review","relate","unrelate","state","comment"] => requires(task_id) | IF action=="checkpoint" => requires(checkpoint) | IF action in ["relate","unrelate"] => requires(relation_kind,related_task_id) | IF action=="state" => requires(state) | IF action=="review" => requires(dimensions,verdict) | IF action=="comment" => requires(comment_text) | IF action=="archive" => require_at_least_one(archive_note,note)).
rules (server): create requires non-null isolation_hint. update requires non-null expected_revision (minimum 1) and task_id. For every action the accepted field whitelist, required fields and extra_forbidden policy are compiled from _TASK_MANAGE_MODELS, not from the permissive union.; checkpoint requires non-null checkpoint; state requires non-null state; review requires non-null dimensions (1..3 distinct A/C/R) and verdict; comment requires non-null comment_text with at least one non-whitespace character; relate/unrelate require non-null relation_kind and related_task_id.; archive requires either non-null archive_note or non-null note at canonical model level. Runtime selects raw archive_note if truthy, else note; it then strips and requires non-whitespace text. archive_note="   " masks valid note fallback and fails; supply one meaningful field. create with state=done requires non-null result.; The handler serializes with exclude_none=True and exclude_unset=True; update description:null is omitted/no change, while tags:[] explicitly replaces the stored list with an empty list. Other explicit non-null collection values replace, not append.; relation_kind is an open string(1..64), not an enum. For relation_kind=review_of on relate: source lane must be review; parent candidate_ref must be nonempty; no different review_of parent; source candidate_ref if set must match parent, otherwise it is bound from parent. Possible errors review_task_required, missing_parent_candidate, ambiguous_review_parent, candidate_conflict.; Canonical update/mutation state transitions and task revision checks remain enforced by the existing server; an omitted optional field may mean no mutation.; request_id on create is the stable operation identity; reuse only on transport retries of the same create; independent creates need a fresh request_id.; action=update: With a live claim, nonowner update permits only safe participant fields title, description, next_action, tags; workflow fields or non-null dependencies require live owner (owner_required). expected_revision is required.; action=update: update rejects non-null state and checkpoint; use dedicated state/checkpoint actions.; action=update: Non-null update candidate_ref returns candidate_ref_frozen when task is done or has incoming review_of, even for unchanged value; null is omitted.; action=state: Admitted nonowners may set workflow state despite a live claim; no content revision CAS check/increment, existing claim unaffected.; When any claim is live, archive, relate and unrelate require the live owner; nonowners get owner_required. Without a live claim this owner gate does not apply..

message.description:

Either alert=true or require_reply=true forces final mode=alert even when mode=notify or mode=ack. mode=ack is a delivery mode, distinct from action=ack. Send mode defaults to notify. mode=notify marks read_at automatically on first recipient display, so acknowledged=true means read/handled and does not prove an explicit ACK. mode=ack requires action=ack to set read_at. mode=alert requires a reply to release its reply obligation; action=ack alone does not satisfy it. Either alert=true or require_reply=true promotes notify/ack to alert. first_seen_at records first display; read_at records notify auto-read or explicit ACK; replied_at records actual reply. Repeated ACK is idempotent and creates no new message.; Local send routes are exclusive: use target=<local public_name> with namespace/task_id absent, OR namespace + task_id together for the task’s current local owners, with target absent/null or broadcast. session.description:
Attach this connector once using session_number. Use action='attach' with session_number and optional initial intent. Repeated attach preserves existing intent and its timer. Before any domain write, set intent here with action='intent', intent=...; refresh uses the existing binding and never needs session_number. Refresh intent every 180 seconds. The first due call warns; the next write is blocked until refresh. Reads, cancel, recovery, release and message ACK/reply remain available under their existing policy. The issuer provides the session number. The local binding survives restart and automatic work-cycle rearm. Use the issuer connector to begin and end the shared session cycle. Contract updated for Terminal MCP 0.14.1.
